Sandbox_EngineFixesAndTweaks_EnableCapac: Enable configurable replacements for the vanilla 50 and 100 capacity ceilings.
Sandbox_EngineFixesAndTweaks_EnableWeapo: Enable the fix for non-Axe weapons reporting one level below the corresponding weapon skill.
Sandbox_EngineFixesAndTweaks_InventoryIt: Replacement for the vanilla 50 capacity ceiling used by inventory items such as bags and character.
Sandbox_EngineFixesAndTweaks_DefaultCont: Replacement for the vanilla 100 capacity ceiling used by other containers.
